nodes.description: Public uint256 holding the minimum claimable amount; written by owner via setMinClaimAmount and read by claim.
Array of accepted merkle root hashes set by the owner and read during proof verification.
Mapping address=>uint256 tracking already claimed token amounts; read and written in claim.
IERC20 reward token reference set during initialize and used for transfers.
Owner address from OwnableUpgradeable used to enforce onlyOwner access control.
ReentrancyGuard status flag (NOT_ENTERED/ENTERED) guarding the claim function.
Pausable flag controlling whether claim is allowed to execute.
Initializer that sets up Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard and the reward token address.
Owner-only setter that updates minAmountToClaim.
Owner-only setter that replaces the merkleRoots array.
Owner-only function transferring the full token balance to a recipient.
External nonReentrant whenNotPaused entry point that verifies merkle proofs and transfers tokens to the caller.
View function verifying the merkle proof of an account and amount against a stored root.
Owner-only function pausing claims.
Owner-only function unpausing claims.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to a new address.
Owner-only function renouncing ownership.
View function returning the current owner address.
Untrusted caller address obtained via _msgSender(); determines claim recipient and eligibility.
External ERC20 transfer of availableAmount to the caller inside claim.
External ERC20 transfer of the full contract balance to the recipient inside withdrawToken.
Constructor-style parameter of initialize specifying the reward token address.
Parameter of setMinClaimAmount specifying the new minimum claim amount.
Parameter of setMerkleRoots supplying the new array of merkle roots.
Parameter of withdrawToken specifying the token recipient.
Parameter of claim selecting which merkle root to use.
Parameter of claim giving the maximum allowed claim amount for the caller.
Parameter of claim carrying the merkle proof hashes.
Parameter of transferOwnership specifying the new owner address.
Local variable in claim computed as allowed amount minus previously claimed amount.
Local variable in withdrawToken holding the full token balance of the contract.

edges.reason: claim reads _msgSender() to determine the caller, recipient and eligibility.
claim reads and writes claimed[_msgSender()] to track claimed amounts.
The amount transferred by the external token call is derived from claimed accounting state.
claim executes an external ERC20 transfer to the untrusted caller, creating a reentrancy surface.
Tokens are transferred to the untrusted caller address inside the external call.
claim is guarded by nonReentrant which reads and updates _status.
claim is guarded by whenNotPaused which reads _paused.
claim reads minAmountToClaim to validate the available amount.
claim computes and uses the availableAmount local variable.
claim consumes the _amountAllowedToClaim parameter for the enough modifier and validation.
claim consumes the _merkleProofs parameter when verifying eligibility.
claim consumes the _merkleRootIndex parameter to select a root.
claim calls verifyMerkleProofs to validate the caller proof.
verifyMerkleProofs consumes the _merkleProofs parameter.
verifyMerkleProofs consumes the _amountAllowedToClaim parameter when building the leaf node.
verifyMerkleProofs reads merkleRoots[_merkleRootIndex] to validate the proof.
withdrawToken performs an external ERC20 transfer, creating a reentrancy surface.
withdrawToken consumes the _recipient parameter.
The _recipient parameter is used as the destination of the external transfer.
withdrawToken reads the token state variable to perform the transfer.
claim reads the token state variable to perform the transfer.
withdrawToken computes and uses the amount local variable from the token balance.
The amount local variable is passed as the value of the external transfer.
setMinClaimAmount writes the minAmountToClaim state variable.
setMinClaimAmount consumes the _minAmount parameter.
setMerkleRoots writes the merkleRoots state variable.
setMerkleRoots consumes the _merkleRoots parameter.
initialize writes the token state variable.
initialize consumes the _token parameter.
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter.
pause updates the _paused state variable through _pause.
unpause updates the _paused state variable through _unpause.
setMinClaimAmount is restricted by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
setMerkleRoots is restricted by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
withdrawToken is restricted by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
pause is restricted by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
unpause is restricted by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner which reads _owner.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against _owner to authorize privileged calls.

normalization_plan.reason: The initialize parameter only supplies the token state variable assignment and has no independent identity.
The _minAmount parameter exists solely to write minAmountToClaim inside setMinClaimAmount.
The _merkleRoots parameter exists solely to assign the merkleRoots state variable inside setMerkleRoots.
The _recipient parameter only determines the destination of the withdrawal performed by withdrawToken.
The _merkleRootIndex parameter is consumed only by the claim entry point and its proof verification.
The _amountAllowedToClaim parameter is consumed only by claim and its merkle proof verification.
The _merkleProofs parameter is consumed only by claim when validating eligibility.
The newOwner parameter exists solely to update _owner inside transferOwnership.
The availableAmount local is a temporary calculation used only within the claim transfer flow.
The amount local is a temporary balance read used only within withdrawToken's transfer.
